```yaml
name: Prompt Test
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      environment:
        description: 'Environment to deploy to'
        required: true
        default: 'staging'
        type: choice
        options:
          - staging
          - production
jobs:
  test-prompt:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 8
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'pnpm'
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm build
      - name: Run test task
        run: |
          pnpm exec trigger dev --run --task=sentry-error-test
        env:
          NODE_ENV: ${{ github.event.inputs.environment }}
          SENTRY_DSN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_DSN }}
          SENTRY_ORG: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_ORG }}
          SENTRY_PROJECT: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_PROJECT }}
          SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          SENTRY_RELEASE: ${{ github.sha }}
          TRIGGER_DEV_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.TRIGGER_DEV_API_KEY }}
          TRIGGER_DEV_URL: ${{ secrets.TRIGGER_DEV_URL }}
      - name: Upload Sentry release
        uses: getsentry/action-release@v1
        with:
          environment: ${{ github.event.inputs.environment }}
          inject: true
          sourcemaps: true
          dist: ${{ github.sha }}
          finalize: true
          version: ${{ github.sha }}
          version_prefix: v
          set_commits: true
          projects: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_PROJECT }}
          url_prefix: https://github.com/liam-hq/liam
          strip_common_prefix: true
          working_directory: .
```
